packet_dag.terminal_condition: The Rabbi / One Time Operations provider workspace filter rail and provider heading are readable on desktop and mobile screenshots, with no behavior/data changes and after-audit evidence or a precise blocker.

title: Provider Workspace Contrast And Filter Rail Readability

reasons: Manual review of the latest after-audit screenshots shows the active top filter rail label is nearly unreadable because a dark active-state color wins over the light rail surface.
The shared provider heading band is visible on Program, Participants, and Payment/Access screenshots but its title and helper text are too low contrast against the dark panel.
The fix is confined to CSS/readability for the existing provider Operations shell and does not require data, route, workflow, registry, or external-provider changes.
affected_product_surfaces: Operations Rabbi / One Time provider workspace shell
likely_external_provider_blockers: External publishing, email, WhatsApp, Stripe/payment, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, and access-grant writes are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this contrast/readability cleanup, choose the next packet only from fresh after-audit screenshot review or deploy/live-smoke blocker closeout.

requirements.statement: Fix low-contrast selected top filter tabs and shared provider heading text in the Rabbi / One Time Operations provider workspace shell.

acceptance_criteria: The active top filter tab has an explicit readable text color in the light Operations rail and remains visually selected.

Mobile Program Overview screenshot shows the active rail item and provider heading readable without introducing horizontal page overflow.
No API handlers, route access, data loading, provider setup, or external-provider actions change.
